paras: Enhance the stance and precision of your Mercedes-AMG A35 / A45 (W177) with AST Adjustable Lowering Springs. This system allows you to customise your ride height using the factory dampers, providing an aggressive, lower centre of gravity without sacrificing the performance or driveability of the W177 platform.

Developed to work seamlessly with the original Mercedes suspension, these springs reduce body roll and sharpen steering response for a more planted feel. Every kit is 100% made in the Netherlands to ensure premium quality and long-term durability for high-performance applications.
hl: Precision Adjustment: Set your preferred ride height using the height adjusters on the original OEM dampers.
Improved Handling: Lowered centre of gravity results in better cornering stability and a more direct steering feel.
Ride Quality: Engineered to improve aesthetics while maintaining the comfort expected of a modern AMG.
Quality Assurance: 100% Made in The Netherlands and backed by a lifetime warranty against breaking.
ft: AST Adjustable Lowering Spring (ALS) for Mercedes-AMG A35 / A45 (W177)
